title: ability.resolve
description: host → server. The host accepts or declines an ability.requested. On accept the server marks the ability spent and broadcasts ability.used and roles.state; on decline it sends error ABILITY_REJECTED to the player and the ability stays available.

accepted.description: True when the host applied the ability effect.

reason.description: Why it was declined; null when accepted.

AbilityRejectReason.description: Why the host declined an ability.

RequestId.description: Ability request identifier chosen by the server; unique within the room.
